definitions.explanation: Cream beaten until light and stiff; in Japanese shops also a ready-made whipped topping made from vegetable fat.

examples.japanese: ホイップクリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる。
⟦パンケーキ→パンケーキ：28809_pankeeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ホイップクリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{添|そ}えた→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: I served the pancakes with plenty of whipped cream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泡立|あわだ}てて→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧、⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ホイップクリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I whipped fresh cream to make homemade whipped cream.

notes:
In Japanese stores the word also covers ready-made toppings made from vegetable fat, which are cheaper than whipped dairy cream; the label says which. Standard on cakes, crepes, pancakes and café drinks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ホイップクリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧: to pipe whipped cream
- ホイップクリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる: to top with whipped cream
- ホイップクリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to serve with whipped cream

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧: fresh dairy cream; also, loosely, whipped dairy cream
- ホイップ: whipped topping (short form)
- ⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧: to whip, to beat
